external_corpus.verification: Before using any text, require exactly 1115394 raw bytes AND git blob SHA1 of b'blob '+ascii(len(raw))+b'\0'+raw = 7dcb...; abort on fetch/hash drift. Input is preexisting PUBLIC heavily studied English Shakespeare, NOT independent blinded first-use; no API payment.
external_corpus.copyright: Only model outputs/aggregate numeric evidence and tiny snippets if essential; do not commit source text or large verbatim excerpts.

task.type: two-word gap reconstruction in continuous authentic text
task.tokenizer: lowercase ASCII regex [a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)? applied independently per original physical line, no cross-line context
task.source_rows: Take lines with 9-40 regex tokens. Choose exactly one interior gap per eligible line: gap index 3+ (int.from_bytes(SHA256(UTF8(namespace+':'+ascii physical line index))[:8],'big')%(len(tokens)-6)), produce 3 preceding word tokens, 2 gold missing tokens, 3 following. Source identity is line index only, not speaker label.
task.split: Assign candidate physical lines chronologically by physical-line ordinal, not random episode-by-episode: first 70% physical lines TRAIN, next 15% SELECT, final 15% DEV. Then select earliest valid candidates per slice: 1200 TRAIN, 300 SELECT, 300 DEV. If insufficient eligible rows, fail closed; do not retune quotas after inspection. No text from DEV is used to train/select or build vocabulary.
task.new_role_identity: Each role SHA256 canonical JSON of public prefix-left, suffix-right, exact 2-word gold, physical line ordinal for custody only; line index is NEVER predictor input.
task.output: Predict exactly two missing word tokens given same three left and three right words; evaluate DEV per word accuracy, 2-word exact match, OOV coverage and real text context failure. No autonomous semantic reasoning or coding competency tested.

models.P_SLOT_INDEPENDENT: Two independently trained smoothed categorical heads per position conditioned on left last word and right first word; frozen hierarchical backoff and same 1200 FIT rows.
models.SEQ_CONDITIONAL: Autoregressive smoothed two-word conditional model trained on same 1200 rows with second slot conditioned on first generated, plus left and right context. Fit counts; greedy sequential decoding. Learned conventional word n-gram baseline, not a neural LM.
models.JOINT_SPAN_COUNT: Fit joint two-word span as one learned categorical object conditional on full left/right boundary tokens, with deterministic backoff.
models.P_WITH_SELECT_REPAIR: Reuse trained P_SLOT_INDEPENDENT and SEQ_CONDITIONAL, repair second predicted word only if sequential log-score margin > frozen selected threshold. Threshold chosen solely SELECT among [0,0.5,1.0] nats. Include both model checkpoints and fit+selection cost.
models.FIT_PRIOR: Fitted global top word per position, zero context, chance-frequency control.

train.feature_hierarchy: First lookup (left[-1],right[0]); if unseen use left[-1]; else right[0]; else global frequency; no DEV threshold tuning.
train.selection: Only SELECT may choose repair margin; all other model/backoff decisions fixed beforehand; no DEV model selection or fits.
train.model_storage: Count all vocab/context tables serialized in deterministic canonical JSON; checkpoint bytes are compressed? NO use raw canonical only.

evaluation.primary: Exact two-word gap match on frozen chronologically held DEV; both token positions individually; OOV counts; per-example output hashes; no examples emitted verbatim.
evaluation.cost: Full fit/SELECT CPU and inference CPU+wall per example, peak RSS/tracemalloc, checkpoint bytes, training/selection source bytes, candidate evaluation lookup count proxy, conceptual sequential dependency stages, known no actual parallel hardware. FLOPs and energy NOT_MEASURED.
evaluation.cross_os: All three role SHA256 exact and all five model DEV aggregate metrics and output SHA256 text-exact, after native hosted Win/Linux runs, with independent fail-closed reconciliation.
evaluation.no_claims: This is a PUBLIC real corpus with familiar Shakespeare, not independently sourced blind assessment. No learned recurrent/state-space/transformer capacity-matched neural controls this gate; interpret comparisons as diagnostic only. No scientific/Pareto GO.
evaluation.negative_control: Preserve unknown-vocab, zero exact score and unsuccessful repair outcomes.

source_only_files: All L4 research files + one hosted workflow additive on protected main; no changes to active work or queue; leave PR draft/unmerged.
